entries.head: traceql
entries.rationale: Defensive: a nested-set intrinsic is always numeric (TypeInt), so a comparison pairing a negated nested-set operand with a non-numeric literal (string/boolean) fails the AST-level operand-type-match rule at parse time ("binary operations must operate on the same type") before this lowering code ever runs — no parseable query reaches it.

entries.message: traceql: intrinsic %s is not a nested-set position
entries.rationale: Defensive: reached only via a nested-set intrinsic attribute, for which nestedSetColumn always resolves, so the not-a-position branch is unreachable.
